text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Feeling the change of seasons while at the 
racetrack is truly wonderful, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"For example... let's see, near the main 
gate of Tokyo Racecourse—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Near the main gate, the season...\nAh, 
you mean that magnificent garden!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Fufu. If it's there, then I'll—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Every time I go, I find myself wondering 
if it's taken on the colors of a new 
season— and before I know it, my feet have 
carried me there.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Is that so, Bouquet-san, you too...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you really do end up checking every 
single time you go, don't you...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Wonder what the 'seasonal bean paste' 
flavor is for the GⅠ-yaki today..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... um! If you'd like, sometime soon... 
would you like to go eat GI-yaki 
together...?
